Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: A customer of the confectionery shop with credit balance, weekly SMS reminder settings, and contact details.

phone.description: Phone number for SMS alerts and weekly credit reports.

creditBalance.description: Current outstanding credit balance owed by the customer.

totalBilled.description: Cumulative amount billed to this customer.

totalPaid.description: Cumulative amount paid/submitted by this customer.

weeklyReminderEnabled.description: Whether weekly SMS credit reminders are enabled for this customer.

lastReminderSentAt.description: Formatted timestamp of the last SMS reminder or report sent.

loyaltyPoints.description: Confectionery loyalty reward points earned by the customer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when customer record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when customer record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: A confectionery product or stock item with pricing, quantity, low-stock threshold, and expiry date.

category.description: Category such as Chocolates, Traditional Sweets, Pastries, Gift Hampers.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (box, kg, pack, pc).

lowStockThreshold.description: Threshold at or below which low stock alert triggers.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when item was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when item was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ShopTransaction.title: ShopTransaction
ShopTransaction.description: An itemized purchase bill or credit payment record with date/time and customer link.

customerId.description: ID of the customer or walk_in.

itemsSummary.description: Itemized breakdown of what was bought or payment note.

totalAmount.description: Total bill amount for the purchase.

paidAmount.description: Amount paid/submitted by the customer during this transaction.

balanceDelta.description: Net change to customer credit balance (totalAmount - paidAmount).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when transaction was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}.description: Per-owner collection of confectionery shop customers and their credit balances.

/users/{userId}/inventory/{itemId}.description: Per-owner collection of confectionery stock items, prices, and batch expiry dates.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Per-owner collection of itemized customer purchases, bills, and credit payments.
